final_draft.answer: Yes. Our AWS account (111122223333) blocks all public access to S3 buckets account-wide.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer word for word (owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-18, control CC6.6). A live read-only check on 2026-11-18 at 03:46 UTC confirmed that AWS account 111122223333 blocks all public access to S3 buckets account-wide. All four block settings were on: block_public_acls, ignore_public_acls, block_public_policy and restrict_public_buckets. The approved answer and the check both cover only this one account. Neither says whether there are other AWS accounts or other object storage providers.
